rules: An explicit operator launch of the exact setup revision precedes all dispatch and execution.
This seed is not a daemon or evidence an agent ran. Bind actual inputs, write paths, remaining budgets and reviewer at dispatch.
A hard dependency requires its actual handback or explicit blocker disposition. A model gate additionally requires applicable independent PASS evidence, not merely a returned handback.
Blocked optional model work cannot block separable deterministic execution or honest partial delivery.
Count every substantive dispatch/reactivation and root implementation assignment. Continued work inside one unchanged task does not manufacture a new assignment.
Ten seed pre-final tasks leave up to eight pre-final repair/consultation assignments within the 18-slot build ceiling; use only what is needed.
Hold six slots for H00 final integration, three distinct final reviews, one optional affected recheck and root delivery.
No author self-acceptance, recursive spawning, shared-file write races, hidden model calls or budget transfers.
A post-freeze change invalidates affected evidence. Re-freeze, recheck and obtain reviewer applicability within the remaining original IP-02 caps; otherwise deliver PARTIAL.
Root owns Git/publication and shared ledgers. H00 owns integration decisions, not root identity or acceptance.
